Ja Morant has never been afraid of attacking the biggest player in the paint—and this moment against Victor Wembanyama captured that fearless mentality perfectly. During a January 2025 matchup, Morant exploded toward the rim and elevated over the 7-foot-4 Spurs star, throwing down a powerful one-handed slam that looked like a picture-perfect poster. The play had everything: explosive athleticism, incredible elevation, and the audacity to challenge one of the NBA’s most intimidating rim protectors.  Although a whistle had already stopped the action, meaning the dunk didn’t officially count, the visual impact was impossible to ignore. Wembanyama may have been waiting at the rim, but Morant attacked anyway. No fear, no hesitation—just pure Ja Morant energy. #basketball #nba
